name: ssh-bare-login-is-not-gated
note: GUARD: `ssh host` is an interactive login with no remote command and no tunnel flag, so neither bash-ssh-remote-command nor bash-ssh-tunnel fires. `ssh -p 2222 host` is also a guard: value-taking flags consume their argument so the port is never mistaken for a command. Fails closed to gommage; it does NOT become an ask_picto for net.ssh:exec.
